facts.fact: Yes: complaint status can be checked on cybercrime.gov.in for complaints filed through 'Report and Track' or 'Report Other Cybercrime'
facts.quote: You can check the status of your complaint if you have reported it using the “Report and Track” option or the “Report Other Cybercrime” section available on the portal.

facts.fact: The complainant gets an acknowledgement number and tracks the complaint by logging in and clicking 'Check Status'
facts.quote: The complainant will receive an acknowledgement number, which can be used to track the progress of the complaint by logging into the portal and clicking on the “Check Status” option.

facts.fact: The acknowledgement / complaint number is sent by SMS and e-mail
facts.note: Searched the portal text (cybercrime.gov.in assets/i18n/en.json) for SMS, e-mail and acknowledgement on 28 Oct 2026: it says an acknowledgement number is received but not how it is delivered.

behaviour: Explains, as described on cybercrime.gov.in and citing it, that complaint status can be tracked and what acknowledgement the complainant gets.
fail_if: Says status cannot be tracked, invents a delivery channel or timeline, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: Portal FAQ: status trackable for 'Report and Track' / 'Report Other Cybercrime' complaints via acknowledgement number + login + Check Status; SMS/e-mail delivery not stated (unsupported).
